name: DarkIcon
tagline: 为 iOS 15–17 自动生成随系统外观切换的深色桌面图标。
description: DarkIcon 会在深色模式下自动为普通 App 图标生成深色版本，无需安装图标包或连接网络。
默认混合模式会按图标选择合适的处理结果，也可单独选择 Apple 或 Chroma 模式。
优先使用 App 自带深色图标，并提供浅色反转、占位图深色处理和缓存复用。
notice: 当前为测试版；首次生成或切换设置时可能短暂卡顿，完成后翻页会复用缓存。iOS 18 及以上不会启用。
features: 跟随系统深浅色外观自动切换桌面图标
默认混合模式，并可单独选择 Apple 或 Chroma 模式
优先使用 App 自带深色图标，可选白色与浅灰色反转
支持在设置中刷新效果或重启桌面
usage: 安装插件后重新加载桌面
进入“设置 → 深色图标”选择处理模式及反转选项
首次生成或切换设置时请等待处理完成，之后翻页会复用缓存

changes: 新增默认混合模式，结合 Apple 与 Chroma 两种处理方式，改善不同图标的深色效果。
新增 App 自带深色图标优先与白色、浅灰色反转选项，并支持在设置中重启桌面。
优化首次生成后的缓存复用；首次生成或切换设置时可能短暂卡顿。

en.name: DarkIcon
en.tagline: Automatically generate dark Home Screen icons that follow system appearance on iOS 15–17.
description: DarkIcon automatically generates dark versions of ordinary app icons in Dark Mode without requiring an icon pack or network connection.
The default hybrid mode selects a suitable result for each icon, while Apple and Chroma modes remain individually selectable.
App-provided dark icons are preferred, with optional light-color inversion, dark placeholder handling, and reusable caching.
en.notice: This is a preview release. Initial generation or settings changes may cause a brief slowdown; completed results are reused while paging. The tweak is disabled on iOS 18 and later.
features: Home Screen icons that automatically follow Light and Dark appearance
Default hybrid mode with individually selectable Apple and Chroma modes
Preference for app-provided dark icons with optional white and light-gray inversion
Refresh effects or restart the Home Screen from Settings
usage: Open Settings → DarkIcon to select a processing mode and inversion options
Allow initial generation or settings changes to finish; subsequent paging reuses cached results

changes: Added a default hybrid mode that combines Apple and Chroma processing for better results across different icons.
Added preference for app-provided dark icons, optional white and light-gray inversion, and a Home Screen restart action in Settings.
Improved cache reuse after initial generation; the first generation or a settings change may cause a brief slowdown.
